info.author: LANCommander
info.description: LAN party rotation: votes between game modes and maps, with a few race maps in a row

setting.name: *gamemodes
setting.desc: Comma-separated game mode resources the vote picks from. Empty = every game mode except play.

setting.name: *start
setting.desc: Game mode started (with a random map) when the server starts. Empty = a random one from the list.

setting.name: *vote_options
setting.desc: How many mode + map choices each vote offers (Play again comes on top).

setting.name: *race_maps
setting.desc: Race maps played (picked by the race map vote) before the next vote also offers the other game modes.

setting.name: *time_limit
setting.desc: Starts the vote when a non-race map has run this long without its round ending (modes like fallout, hay, tdma and ctv never end a round on their own). 0 = off.

setting.name: *vote_delay
setting.desc: Seconds between a round ending and the vote, so players can see the scores.

setting.name: *recent_maps
setting.desc: Maps played this recently are left out of the vote when there are others.

setting.name: *color
setting.desc: Color of the rotation's chat messages.
